trigger.aggregate: maximum line_effective_cost_bps across baseline cost-ledger lines; empty maximum is 0
trigger.decision: triggered is true iff the baseline cost ledger has at least one line and aggregate >= 50
trigger.integer_arithmetic: ceil_ratio with positive integer numerator and denominator

roles.BASELINE: Exact primary_deterministic action and quantity for every asset.
roles.NO_CHANGE: hold with quantity 0 for every asset.
roles.HALF_BASELINE_DELTA: For each non-hold baseline decision, compute lots = quantity / lot_size_shares and scaled_lots = floor(lots / 2). Preserve action with quantity scaled_lots * lot_size_shares when scaled_lots > 0; otherwise use hold quantity 0.
roles.DROP_MAX_COST_TRADE: Copy BASELINE. If the baseline cost ledger is nonempty, choose the line with greatest total_cost_cents, breaking ties by lexicographically smallest asset_id, and replace that asset decision with hold quantity 0.

candidate_generator.integer_lot_rule: Every non-hold quantity must be an exact positive multiple of lot_size_shares.
candidate_generator.validation_rule: Validate all four generated raw batches before deduplication. Any raw-invalid, fallback, or executable mismatch produces PRE_PROVIDER_INTEGRITY_STOP; do not repair or drop the invalid candidate.
candidate_generator.deduplication_rule: Deduplicate by canonical_candidate_id in role_order_before_deduplication order. Retain the first role and record later duplicate roles as aliases.
candidate_generator.provider_call_eligibility: A provider call is eligible only when trigger is true and candidate count after deduplication is at least 2. Trigger false or K=1 executes BASELINE with a no-call artifact.

payload_shape.decisions: object keyed by A0 through A5; each value contains only action and quantity

candidate_canonicalization.serialization: UTF-8 JSON, keys sorted recursively, separators comma and colon with no whitespace, ASCII escaping enabled, no trailing newline
candidate_canonicalization.canonical_candidate_id: lowercase hex SHA-256 of serialized payload bytes

presentation_permutation.overlay_spec_sha256: SHA-256 of the exact bytes of this freeze JSON file
presentation_permutation.permutation_seed: HMAC-SHA256 with root_seed_utf8 bytes as key and seed_message bytes as message
presentation_permutation.candidate_order_key: HMAC-SHA256 with permutation_seed raw bytes as key and canonical_candidate_id ASCII bytes as message
presentation_permutation.ordering: ascending tuple of candidate_order_key lowercase hex and canonical_candidate_id
presentation_permutation.presented_ids: Assign P00, P01, ... in ordered position
presentation_permutation.selector_visibility: The selector sees presented IDs and candidate contents but not canonical roles, aliases, canonical IDs, seed inputs, or permutation map.

requirements: candidate count after deduplication is at least 2
max true utility among generated candidates minus BASELINE true utility is greater than 0
challenge_stratum_admission.oracle_barrier: Challenge admission is provider-free frame classification after trigger and candidate bytes are immutable. Admission fields are not available to trigger, generator, permutation, or selector request.

replay_requirements: Recompute baseline, cost ledger, trigger inputs, and trigger decision.
Recompute all four candidate roles, validation reports, aliases, and canonical IDs.
Recompute permutation and presented ID map from frozen hashes.
Prove no oracle or hidden field entered any pre-selection artifact.
Prove no-call episodes leave provider-attempt count unchanged.
